whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Paprika Pure Veg Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 4.2★ reviews with nearly 400 reviews on Arya Kumar Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur popular pure veg dishes integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/paprika

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Paprika Pure Veg Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your pure veg specialties in Rajendra Nagar, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, pricing, aur food photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
